items.title: Company Secretary
items.summary: Fulfil the statutory duties of Company Secretary for Joybringers Ltd, ensuring compliance with Companies House and Charity Commission requirements.
items.about: The Company Secretary is a key governance role responsible for ensuring Joybringers Ltd meets its legal obligations as a registered company and charity. You will work closely with the Board of Trustees and senior leadership to keep statutory records up to date, manage filings, and support good governance practice across the organisation.
responsibilities: File annual confirmation statements and returns with Companies House
Maintain the statutory registers (directors, members, charges)
Ensure timely filing of accounts and reports with the Charity Commission
Support the Chair in scheduling and administering board meetings
Prepare and circulate board minutes and resolutions
Advise trustees on their legal and regulatory obligations
Manage official correspondence with regulators and Companies House
requirements: Understanding of UK company law and charity governance (Companies Act 2006)
Experience in a company secretary, legal, or governance role is desirable
High level of accuracy, confidentiality, and attention to detail
Ability to interpret and apply regulatory guidance
Strong written communication skills
gains: Hands-on experience in charity and company governance
Exposure to board-level decision making and strategy
Professional development in regulatory compliance
Professional reference from the Chair or CEO
Certificate of volunteering

Experience in financial reporting, audit, or treasury management
Commitment to Joybringers’ mission and values
Ability to attend quarterly Board meetings (in-person or online)
gains: Non-executive board experience with a registered charity
Exposure to charity governance and the Charity Commission framework
Opportunity to directly shape the financial future of a growing charity
Certificate of trusteeship and professional reference

items.title: Administrative Assistant
items.summary: Keep day-to-day operations running smoothly with strong organisational and admin support.
items.about:
As our Administrative Assistant, you will play an important role in supporting the smooth day-to-day operation of Joybringers. You will help the team manage communications, records, volunteers, events and general office administration.

This is a Newcastle-based role. You must live in Newcastle upon Tyne or the surrounding area and be available to work from our office at least once a week. The remaining duties may be completed remotely, depending on organisational needs.

No previous administrative experience is required. Full training and ongoing support will be provided.
responsibilities: Manage emails, appointments, calendars and meeting bookings.
Respond professionally to general enquiries from the public, volunteers, beneficiaries and partner organisations.
Welcome visitors and support office sign-in and sign-out procedures.
Assist with onboarding new staff members, volunteers and trainees.
Use Microsoft 365 Admin and other digital tools to create accounts, provide system access and support new starters.
Maintain and update the organisation’s administrative and CRM systems.
Keep staff, volunteer, beneficiary and partner information accurate and up to date.
Update information on internal and external platforms when required.
Prepare, format and proofread letters, reports, presentations, forms and other documents.
Maintain organised electronic and paper filing systems.
Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions.
Support with staff and volunteer Travel reimbursement records, timesheets and rotas.
Assist with event planning, registration, attendance lists, communications and logistics.
Support training programmes by preparing materials, maintaining participant records and issuing certificates.
Liaise with community organisations, suppliers, partners and other stakeholders.
Assist with basic data entry, monitoring information and administrative reports.
Keep office supplies, equipment and resources organised.
Help promote organisational activities by sharing approved updates through email, the website, CRM and social media platforms.
Handle personal and organisational information confidentially and in accordance with data-protection requirements.
requirements: Previous experience is not essential. The successful candidate will receive training in:
Joybringers’ administrative and CRM systems
Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Admin tools
Staff and volunteer onboarding procedures
Office sign-in and sign-out processes
Record management and data protection
Safeguarding and confidentiality
Event and programme administration
Internal communication and reporting procedures
gains: Broad office administration experience
Understanding of charity operations
Professional reference from the Charity Director
Certificate of volunteering
